Edit current BK7258 Wi-Fi implementation to fix final review findings. Use apply_patch. Work in both contest BK7258 board tree and bk_avdk_smp CP only as needed. Do not package, but build/syntax check.

Required fixes:
1. AP deadlock: never call netdev_lower_carrier_on/off, netdev_lower_rxready, netdev_lower_txdone, or netpkt_free while packet_lock is held. Refactor worker/data handling to collect notifications/completions and invoke after unlocking. Ensure lock order cannot be packet_lock -> NuttX network lock while transmit is network lock -> packet_lock. wifi_set_carrier from command event must happen outside packet_lock.
2. Generation coalescing: do not depend solely on link callback seeing non-READY. In worker and/or READY callback compare bk7258_mailbox_peer_reset_generation against g_wifi.reset_generation and run generation synchronization before processing nodes. Refactor reset synchronization into helper. Never dereference stale pointers. Do not block forever on a future-generation node.
3. CP cif_dnld_buffer: propagate cif_msg_sender failures. Because source mailbox callback uses uint8_t but BK errors may be negative, inspect typedef. Return nonzero failure so mailbox sends COM_FAIL and AP transport callback sees failure. More importantly AP command and data sends need transport completion callbacks that reclaim command/TX ownership when COM_FAIL proves CP did not accept node. For successful ACK ownership remains CP. Add callbacks and safe per-slot state as necessary. Do not reclaim on timeout/reset where acceptance is uncertain. For data recycle path existing callback already retries.
4. AP command send currently uses callback NULL. Add transport callback tied to command slot so COM_FAIL can set pattern free/owned false and wake pending command with error. Avoid stack callback arg. AP TX send callback on definite EREMOTEIO should clear active and free packet/txdone outside packet_lock; on timeout/reset quarantine. Respect upper-half packet ownership.
5. CP scan start: call bk_wifi_scan_start first, confirm int32 status, return actual status. AP scan start must request and validate 4-byte status before setting scan_running. If start fails, return error and do not stay busy.
6. For proven peer reset, orphan accepted command slots can be safely reset only if CP reset means old CP cannot access AP pointers. Clear command pattern/owned and wake requests. TX slots remain quarantined because DMA safety is uncertain per current documented choice. CP event slots are CP-owned and can be reset in CP reset handling only if a suitable hook exists; otherwise document residual.
7. Build AP exact command with -Werror. Syntax-check CP files or incremental compile. Return exact changes and residual reset orphan limitations.

237:   wifi_command_reap();
238:   slot = wifi_command_alloc();
239:   if (slot == NULL)

241:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
242:       return -ENOMEM;
243:     }

245:   cpdu = (struct bk7258_wifi_cpdu *)(slot->bytes + sizeof(uint32_t));
246:   header = (struct bk7258_wifi_msg_hdr *)(cpdu + 1);

248:   memset(cpdu, 0, sizeof(*cpdu) + sizeof(*header) + payload_length);
249:   cpdu->length = sizeof(*cpdu) + sizeof(*header) + payload_length;
250:   header->cmd_id = command;
251:   header->cmd_sn = sequence;
252:   header->length = payload_length;
253:   if (payload != NULL && payload_length != 0)
254:     {
255:       memcpy(header + 1, payload, payload_length);
256:     }
257: 
258:   while (nxsem_trywait(&g_wifi.command_sem) == OK)
259:     {
260:     }
261: 
262:   {
263:     irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
264: 
265:     g_wifi.waiting_id = command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET;
266:     g_wifi.waiting_sequence = sequence;
267:     g_wifi.command_result = -ETIMEDOUT;
268:     g_wifi.command_length = 0;
269:     up_irq_restore(flags);
270:   }
271:   ret = wifi_send_node(BK7258_WIFI_CMD_TX_CHANNEL, 0,
272:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu,
273:                        (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)cpdu, 1);
274:   if (ret < 0)
275:     {
276:       *(uint32_t *)slot->bytes = BK7258_WIFI_CMD_PATTERN_FREE;
277:       slot->owned = false;
278:       {
279:         irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
280: 
281:         if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
282:             g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
283:           {
284:             g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
285:           }
286:         up_irq_restore(flags);
287:       }
288:       nxmutex_unlock(&g_wifi.command_lock);
289:       return ret;
290:     }
291: 
292:   ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_wifi.command_sem,
293:                                        WIFI_COMMAND_TIMEOUT);
294:   {
295:     irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
296: 
297:     if (g_wifi.waiting_id == command + BK7258_WIFI_CFM_OFFSET &&
298:         g_wifi.waiting_sequence == sequence)
299:       {
300:         g_wifi.waiting_id = 0;
301:       }
302:     if (ret >= 0)

304:         ret = g_wifi.command_result;
305:       }
306:     up_irq_restore(flags);

309:   if (ret >= 0 && result != NULL && result_size != 0)
310:     {
311:       uint16_t copy = g_wifi.command_length < result_size ?

225: bk_err_t cif_rxdata_pre_process(uint8_t channel,void* head,uint8_t need_retry)
226: {
227:     bk_err_t ret = BK_OK;
228:     uint32_t int_level;
229:     uint8_t ipc_chnl = cif_map_to_ipc_chnl(channel);
230:     
231:     void* first = head;
232:     void* last = head;
233:     uint8_t num = 1;
234:

237:         BK_LOGV(NULL,"%s,%d,p:0x%x,ipc_chnl:%d\n",__func__,__LINE__,(struct pbuf*)head-1,ipc_chnl);

239:         CIF_IRQ_DISABLE(int_level);
240:         co_list_push_back((struct co_list *)&cif_ipc_env[ipc_chnl].rx_list,(struct co_list_hdr *)head);
241:         CIF_IRQ_ENABLE(int_level);
242:     }
243: 
244:     if(cif_ipc_env[ipc_chnl].sending_flag) 
245:     {
246:         return BK_OK;
247:     }
248:     else
249:     {
250:         cif_ipc_env[ipc_chnl].sending_flag =1;
251:     }
252:     
253:     first = (void*)cif_ipc_env[ipc_chnl].rx_list.first;
254:     last = (void*)cif_ipc_env[ipc_chnl].rx_list.last;
255:     num = co_list_cnt((void*)&cif_ipc_env[ipc_chnl].rx_list);
256: 
257:     if(((first != NULL)&&(last!= NULL))&&(num == 0)) BK_ASSERT(0);
258: 
259:     if(first == NULL) goto ERR_EXIT;
260: 
261:     CIF_LOGV("%s,%d,p:0x%x,p:0x%x,num:%d\n",__func__,__LINE__,(struct pbuf*)first-1,(struct pbuf*)last-1,num);

263:     ret = cif_rxbuf_push(channel,first,last,num);
264:     
265:     if(ret != BK_OK){
266:         CIF_LOGE("%s,ipc send fail,0x%x\n",__func__,ret);
267:     }
268:     else{
269:         co_list_init((void*)&(cif_ipc_env[ipc_chnl].rx_list));
270:         return BK_OK;
271:     }
272: ERR_EXIT:
273:     cif_ipc_env[ipc_chnl].sending_flag = 0;
274:     return BK_OK;

Implemented the BK7258 Wi-Fi final-review fixes across the contest AP tree and `bk_avdk_smp` CP tree. No package was generated.

**AP Changes**
- Refactored network notifications in [bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:947):
  - `netpkt_free`, `netdev_lower_txdone`, `netdev_lower_rxready`, and carrier notifications now run outside `packet_lock`.
  - TX/RX completions are collected while locked and delivered after unlocking.
  - RX packet allocation/free no longer occurs while `packet_lock` is held.
- Added command transport completion handling at [bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:231):
  - Definite `-EREMOTEIO` reclaims the command slot and wakes the pending command with an error.
  - Successful ACK leaves ownership with CP.
  - Timeout/reset failures remain quarantined until a proven generation change.
  - Callback arguments use persistent slot storage, never stack addresses.
- Added TX transport completion handling at [bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:922):
  - Definite `COM_FAIL` is deferred to the worker, which clears the active slot, frees the lower-owned packet, and reports `txdone`.
  - Immediate send failure returns the packet to upper-half ownership without freeing it.
  - Timeout/reset keeps TX slots quarantined.
- Added generation synchronization at [bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:436):
  - Worker and all link callbacks compare the mailbox generation.
  - Pending nodes are filtered before processing.
  - Future-generation nodes cannot block the queue indefinitely.
  - CP pointer reads are generation-checked while reset interrupts are excluded.
  - Proven CP resets release old command slots and wake pending commands.
  - Accepted TX slots remain quarantined because DMA safety is still uncertain.
- AP scan start now requires and validates an exact four-byte `int32_t` status before setting `scan_running` at [bk7258_wifi.c](/home/mi/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/chips/bk7258/bk7258_wifi.c:1741).

**CP Changes**
- Added an ABI-compatible status-returning RX callback opcode without renumbering existing mailbox control operations:
  - [mailbox_channel.h](/home/mi
